decision_scope: The operating product may query these KDB objects directly or materialize the same release into an operating database. The bundle is the equivalent snapshot.

kdb_objects.selection_sql: SELECT e.* FROM public.mai_kdb_strict_operational_ready_trigger_export e JOIN public.mai_kdb_construct_first_operational_ready_coaching_line_catalog l ON l.coaching_line_id = e.line_id ORDER BY e.line_id, e.trigger_id

SELECT p.* FROM public.mai_kdb_external_developer_trigger_packet p WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.mai_kdb_strict_operational_ready_trigger_export e JOIN public.mai_kdb_construct_first_operational_ready_coaching_line_catalog l ON l.coaching_line_id = e.line_id WHERE e.line_id = p.line_id AND e.trigger_id = p.trigger_id)

SELECT f.* FROM public.kdb_external_developer_source_field_contract f WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.mai_kdb_strict_operational_ready_trigger_export e JOIN public.mai_kdb_construct_first_operational_ready_coaching_line_catalog l ON l.coaching_line_id = e.line_id WHERE e.line_id = f.line_id AND e.trigger_id = f.trigger_id)

SELECT o.* FROM public.kdb_external_developer_output_contract o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.mai_kdb_strict_operational_ready_trigger_export e JOIN public.mai_kdb_construct_first_operational_ready_coaching_line_catalog l ON l.coaching_line_id = e.line_id WHERE e.line_id = o.line_id AND e.trigger_id = o.trigger_id)

SELECT f.* FROM public.kdb_external_developer_golden_fixture f WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.mai_kdb_strict_operational_ready_trigger_export e JOIN public.mai_kdb_construct_first_operational_ready_coaching_line_catalog l ON l.coaching_line_id = e.line_id WHERE e.line_id = f.line_id AND e.trigger_id = f.trigger_id)

external_inputs_not_in_kdb.note: KDB defines allowed fields and transformations; it does not store the user's raw device records.
The evaluator consumes this normalized input and must not infer disease, diagnosis, recovery, safety, or treatment state from a device signal.

implementation_choices.required: read-only server connection, release-gate check, the five runtime-required KDB objects, and their key joins
implementation_choices.not_required_at_runtime: golden_fixtures unless the service runs validation

implementation_choices.required: versioned materialization of the five runtime-required artifacts or the compiled evaluator_contracts artifact
implementation_choices.refresh_boundary: re-export after a KDB release; do not independently reinterpret source contracts

implementation_choices.required: the files in this bundle; this is equivalent to a versioned projection and requires no KDB connection
